verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-notes product, but the evidence shows only cloud services: an API, an MCP server, integrations and CSV export. None of these let a user run the core product on their own infrastructure. One community user explicitly wishes for a self-hosted or local-processing alternative, and another points to separate local tools instead, which suggests Granola offers no such option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
